header.capture_method: SYNTHETIC. Not captured from the live store or GitHub. Eight PR views authored by the outer loop in the shapes the repository's own conventions produce: the dispatcher's PR body opener and Dispatched-bead line (dispatch.py open_pull_request), the two-line verdict record (scripts/gate_markers.py: Release-gate: <value> then Release-gate-revision: <sha>), and the requeue status note shape dispatch.requeue_task writes. Head and verdict shas are sha1 of a label, not real commits. Bead ids are v4-shaped placeholders.
header.what_the_fixture_is_for: VD-1 AC-2 and AC-4. 'expected' is the outcome decide() must return for each view and 'why' names the evidence the reason string must name. The worker may add views; it may not change an expected value without a note in the PR body saying which convention it found the fixture had wrong.
header.comment_author_note: 'author' on a comment is the GitHub login as gh pr view --json comments returns it; the hardened reader (4e1c33bf) decides attribution from the comment's position and shape, not from this field, so the field is informational here.
header.state_casing: 'state' carries the value gh pr view --json state returns, upper case: OPEN, CLOSED or MERGED (dispatch.py compares against these literals). A view adapter that lower-cases it must not exist; decide() reads these values.
header.revised: 2026-10-08 gate round 1 (MERGE-WITH-CHANGES on a0f4da28): view 2007's requeue note now carries the exact body prefix dispatch.requeue_task writes with the reason in the body and content holding only resets_attempts; states upper-cased to gh casing; view 2009 (MERGED) added so every AC-4 disposition has a case. Gate round 2 (MERGE-WITH-CHANGES on 8a6710b6): the note envelope now matches Substrate.add_note (kind and body inside content, created_at on the envelope), the shape guards.py reads.
